reviews.title: Wrong future predictions by astrologers
reviews.text: Please people, do not install this app as all astrologers are fraud here…they are just minting money and not telling you anything correct about ur near future…I will share with you my experience…I communicated with so many astrologers here and I asked them regarding my baby whether he will be normal and healthy…and all the astrologers told me that my baby will be normal, healthy and I will be blessed to have him in my life…but in reality, I lost my newborn baby in 1.5 day as he was suffering from congenital heart disease…which means and shows that here all astrologers are just minting money and fooling people/customers like us…
reviews.reply:
Hello!

We're deeply saddened to hear about your experience with our app and the loss of your newborn baby 😔. Our hearts go out to you during this difficult time.

We understand your frustration and disappointment with the responses you received from our astrologers. Your trust and confidence in our service are incredibly important to us, and we apologize for any distress caused by the inaccuracies in the information provided.

Please know that we take your feedback seriously and are committed to addressing the concerns you've raised. We will be conducting a thorough review of our astrologers and their practices to ensure that our users receive accurate and reliable guidance.

If there is anything further we can do to support you or if you would like to discuss this matter further, please don't hesitate to reach out to us at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we are here to assist you in any way we can.

Once again, we extend our deepest condolences for your loss, and we apologize for any additional distress caused by your experience with our app.

Best regards,

Nebula Team 🔮

reviews.title: Scam App – Charges You Without Proper Consent
reviews.text:
This app is a scam. It charged my account monthly without clear authorization, and when I contacted their support, they claimed they couldn’t find my account — even though I had payment proof from my bank.

They delayed the response and avoided responsibility. I’ve already reported this to my bank and initiated a dispute process to get my money back.

Do not download this app unless you want to deal with unauthorized charges and unhelpful customer service. Totally untrustworthy.
reviews.reply:
Hello dear User!

Thank you for your feedback. We are sorry that payment problems with our service caused your dissatisfaction.

We want to clarify that auto-renewal of a subscription is never initiated without the user’s prior consent. Before subscribing, all relevant information and conditions regarding renewals are provided, and a confirmation of the purchase along with a reminder about the end of the trial period is always sent to your email. We are sorry to hear that our support team did not meet your expectations. To assist you further, we need to locate the account associated with the payment. It seems that the information you provided was not sufficient for us to find your account.

We truly strive to leave only positive impressions, and we would like to offer further assistance. Please feel free to contact us at nebula.support@nebulahoroscope.com, and we will do our best to help resolve the issue.

Kindest regards, Nebula team 🔮
